liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and with {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} of undrawn committed facilities total liquidity reached {{liquidity@FY2025}}, or {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}} of revenue.
Debt due within a year fell by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, covered {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2025}} by liquidity, so the near-term maturities are met without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, or {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}} of debt, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2025}} to {{net_capex@FY2025}}.
The Brazilian subsidiary BOAB issued secured debentures maturing in the long term, and London Luton airport completed the refinancing of its bank debt.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow after leases fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, taking FCF after leases to debt down by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}}.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}} but absorbing more of operating cash flow.
Margins: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, though it remains above the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue rose by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, in the middle of the group, and covers the {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}} due within a year.
